finding: Readonly probe re-evaluated native context for each signed call without binding principal across the list/status/read sequence. A changed subject could issue the next signed request and combine results.
fix: Bind issuer, subject and environment in memory after native signer validation; reject any changed identity before transport. No identity emitted. Existing approval, expiry, scope and signature controls retained.

reproduction.fixture: Synthetic native contexts and ephemeral local test signing key; no real identity, no live transport.

regression.warning: Existing canonical subprocess harness ResourceWarning remains.

limitations: Candidate only; not deployed or independently reviewed.
No live configuration, key, authentication, ACL or business operations; live 165 rows not accessed.
Old-key signature rejection, live recovery, durable sixty-minute observation and formal QA remain incomplete.
next: Include probe principal binding in independent review of recovery candidates before any approved live read. Do not clear AUTH_CONNECT_NOT_APPROVED.
